_comment: TDD M4 slice: per-route dialect override. Current Go build rejects explicit different dialect at --validate-config (milestone 4+); HTTP expectations below describe the contracted egress (provider-owned auth, dest-keyed URL/headers/classification). Native forwarding rewrites the public rd-chat alias to llama3.1; assert that model and the complete messages array instead of equality with the public request.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.gem]
dialect = "gemini"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}/v1"
api_key = "gem-secret"

[[models]]
name = "rd-chat"
provider = "gem"
model = "llama3.1"
dialect = "openai-chat"
name: m4_route_dialect_gemini_default_chat_native
